narrative.overview: This is code-led evidence for an incumbent app expansion in Operate mode, limited to the refund workspace and its cancellation entry point. The phrase above describes the implemented financial hierarchy; it is not a new project identity or an approved visual comp. Management retains its green Ant Design shell; customer pages retain the rose account shell. Both present the same refund facts with clear amounts, status labels, and dated history.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet white surfaces with restrained shell accents.
Tabular amounts and explicit Vietnamese status labels.
A compact queue with a separate detail drawer.
Processing controls appear only when the server grants permission.

rules.name: The Explicit Status Rule
rules.body: Always pair the semantic tag color with the readable Vietnamese status label in both queue and detail.

rules.name: The Stable Amount Rule
rules.body: Reuse the shared money formatter and tabular numerals for every refund amount; preserve currency in queue, detail, and cancellation confirmation.

dos: Do preserve the active management or customer shell when reusing refund components.
Do keep amounts, status labels, and dated processing history readable together.
Do show the quoted amount and Vietnam-localized cutoff before confirming cancellation.
Do keep owner and customer progress views read-only and follow server-granted processing permission.
donts: Don't use tag color as the only expression of refund status.
Don't present cancellation success or refund-request creation as money already returned.
Don't shrink the table's financial columns to fit mobile; retain inner scrolling and its hint.
Don't derive a global brand or redesign unrelated screens from these scoped conventions.
